required_evidence.description: ALL of the following must be present and verified for EXP_333_01 to proceed.

items.name: different_physical_building
items.description: Target facility must occupy a physically distinct building from Facility Central 01.
items.verification_method: Site ID documentation or independent witness attestation.

items.name: independent_acquisition_session
items.description: Raw footage captured in a completely separate session from all V3.3.x datasets.
items.verification_method: Session ID and timestamp independent of any known V3.3.x session.

items.name: independent_camera_source
items.description: Camera hardware and identifiers not present in central01_exclusion_registry.json.
items.verification_method: Camera ID and SHA-256 hash checked against exclusion registry.

items.name: authenticated_raw_video
items.description: Original, unaltered raw video file with reproducible SHA-256 hash.

items.name: frame_overlap_clear
items.description: Zero frame overlap with V3.3.x datasets confirmed via cryptographic and perceptual fingerprint comparison.

preferred_evidence.description: Preferred but not required for initial provenance verification.

items.name: camera_metadata
items.description: Camera model, serial, and firmware version.

items.name: mounting_height
items.description: Physical mounting height measured in meters.

items.name: pitch_measurement
items.description: Camera pitch angle measured in degrees from horizontal.

items.name: lighting_measurement
items.description: Illuminance measurement in lux at time of recording.

items.name: geometry_survey
items.description: Ground-plane survey with fiducial points for homography calibration.

items.name: continuous_raw_recording
items.description: Unlooped, unedited, timestamp-preserving raw recording export.

items.name: operational_context
items.description: Notes on operational conditions: forklift activity, pedestrian density, environmental hazards.

raw_recording_recommendations.duration: Record actual duration — no fixed minimum required if unavailable
raw_recording_recommendations.minimum_resolution: Actual resolution recorded — do not upscale
raw_recording_recommendations.note: If only limited footage is available, provide it. DATA_VOLUME_STATUS will be assessed from real counts.

preferred_evidence_package_structure.02_camera_metadata: Camera model, serial, firmware, and lens specifications
preferred_evidence_package_structure.03_acquisition_metadata: Session ID, timestamps, operator notes, facility ID
preferred_evidence_package_structure.04_geometry: Ground survey fiducials, floor plan, elevation notes
preferred_evidence_package_structure.05_lighting: Lux measurements, fixture type, uniformity map
preferred_evidence_package_structure.07_tracking_ground_truth: Object trajectories and identity labels (if available)
preferred_evidence_package_structure.08_manifest: Signed or hashed file manifest for the entire package

governance_constraints.note: Do not reject valid footage solely because it does not meet a preferred duration. Record actual values.
